stance_rationale: The package claims M06_MVO_Breadth is the selected production schedule, but the delivered weights.csv is a 5-name M04-style corner portfolio with annual turnover above the 600% hard cap. This is not a minor documentation mismatch; it breaks optimizer handoff, method-shopping honesty, cost audit, and AX-007 exception claims.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: Package claims M06_MVO_Breadth, but stage weights.csv matches M04_MVO_lam2 corner weights.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Delivered weights.csv corresponds to M04: reported one-way cost would be 0.00927, but the role checklist round-trip convention implies 0.01855. Package-selected M06 cost 0.00795 is not the delivered schedule.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O13: delivered weights.csv annual_L1_turnover 6.182472 > 6.0 hard cap

critical_concerns.description: Executable handoff contradicts the package: target_weights says M06 has 15 names with max_w 0.12, but weights.csv has 97 dates with only 5-7 names, final as_of has 5 names at 20%, and turnover is 6.182472/y above the 600% hard cap.
Method shopping cap is violated: candidates_tried=11 while the role prompt requires <=10. Re-labeling the cap as 11 and calling M06 an acceptable extra variant is a post-hoc process override.
Selection objective is unstable: objective is declared net_ir, raw net_ir winner is M04, claimed primary is M06, and delivered CSV reverts to M04. That is not a reproducible optimizer decision rule.

Net alpha is too weak for optimizer admission: claimed M06 net_ir=0.0709 and delivered M04 net_ir=0.0781 are both far below the RF-O2 net_IR 0.3 threshold, before resolving the round-trip cost convention.
CVaR and risk-cap handling is incomplete: daily CVaR95 remains 2.89% if the 2.5% risk cap applies, but infeasibility_report is empty and no CVaR-aware weight adjustment is issued.

Crowding is acknowledged but not acted on: defense hhi_top=0.5366 is handed off as a monitoring item, with no demand-elasticity haircut or weight penalty despite mandatory cost/capacity/crowding treatment.

AX-007 exception is overclaimed. Claimed M06 breadth would be 15 names, but actual weights.csv is a 5-name corner top portfolio, so the single_sleeve_long_only_top20 mechanism break remains unresolved.

Required handoff artifacts are not where the prompt requires them: mailbox weights.csv is absent, optimizer_challenge_note.md is absent, requested qepm/stage parquet paths are absent, and weights.csv schema lacks method_selected.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet in root stage artifacts is a valid time-series panel: 33894 rows, 97 sig_dates, 2015-12-30 to 2023-12-28, no duplicate sig_date/Ticker keys.
root covariance.parquet is numerically usable: 20x20 symmetric, min eigenvalue 0.0001884408, condition number 14.5068112, PSD true.
The target_weights JSON object alone passes max_names, max_w, sum_weights, and long-only checks; the rejection is driven by executable schedule mismatch and turnover/cost/process failures.
The schedule is not single-snapshot; RF-O9 single-snapshot itself is not triggered, but the walk-forward artifact is the wrong method and wrong schema.

weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that the claimed M06_MVO_Breadth package is the actual walk-forward handoff; the delivered weights.csv instead behaves like the rejected M04 corner solution.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate mailbox weights.csv for M06 across all 97 sig_dates with schema as_of_date,ticker,weight,method_selected.
